description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) MORTIS SNARES (Phobos Shadow Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP, the objective control state refreshed. The End Movement Phase action opens movement_phase_end; a REAL click on the Incursor Squad (PHOBOS, controlling obj_nml_2) and a REAL click on obj_nml_2 spend 1 CP; the objective is snared. Then (setup privilege) it is the Ork player's Movement phase, the Phobos units have left the objective and the Warbikers stand 6.5" from it; their real normal move (BEGIN_NORMAL_MOVE + drag + Confirm) ends within range of it: the D6 is rolled (2+: D6 mortal wounds) and the objective is no longer snared.
